messages:
tom: FYI we're seeing repeat PCIe stalls on eu-north shared-gpu hosts during nightly batch exports. 95p spikes from 120ms -> 2.4s around 01:10 UTC.

rachel: any correlating metrics? nvlink, pcierr, nic counters?

tom: nvlink fine. pci-e retrain count increasing on host eu-north-3c-rack-7. NIC TX queues saturate right before stall. Looks like big multi-tenant parallel exporters hitting DMA burst window.

alloc-bot: Autoscaler: tenant=imagelytics pool=shared-gpu-eu-north slots=16 -> +6 at 1746899800

igor: could be contention on host PCIe root complex when simultaneous RDMA+DMA bursts happen. We saw similar with batch-embed jobs last quarter.

mei: ops proposal: two-pronged approach
1) Soft-route heavy export endpoints to an export-optimized variant that streams compressed blobs (reduces egress).
2) Apply egress smoothing policer + PCIe guard via idle-inject to break long bursts.

lee: soft-route is cheap. Dedicated carveouts are expensive and slow to provision in eu-north; procurement wants threshold before approving commit. cost: ~12 slices ~= $13.5k/mo.

igor: vendor note: older eu-north nodes have a weaker root complex (b0 stepping) and show PCIe stalls earlier. If we carve out, we should prefer newer-silicon racks or avoid rack-7.

rachel: quick mitigation: can we apply per-tenant token bucket at proxy to cap sustained export to 150MB/s and allow short bursts? test on rack-7 for 45m.

tom: sounds good. runbook snippet I used before:
```
# throttle at proxy
curl -X POST https://ops-api/internal/policer -d '{"tenant":"imagelytics","rate_mb":150,"burst_mb":50}'
# host-level fallback
ssh root@eu-north-3c-rack-7 'echo 1 > /sys/module/pcie_bus/parameters/idle_inject'
```

alloc-bot: Probe applied: proxy policer for imagelytics active at 1746900200

mei: early signal: egress on rack-7 dropped 460MB/s -> 160MB/s; PCIe retrain events fell to baseline within 90s. 95p latency back down to ~180ms.

lee: good short-term. Next steps:
- Mei/Igor: catalogue racks with weak PCIe root complex and tag them as "avoid-carveout"
- Tom: run a weekend canary dedicated slice on newer racks and capture KV warmup profile
- Rachel: implement soft-route PR that streams gzipped export objects + quantized model option
- Finance (cc Lee): prepare cost/approval for carveout if automation triggers more than twice/month

igor: note: dedicated slice will remove NIC queue contention but won't fix host-level root complex design; we must choose racks wisely. Also quantized variant might increase CPU encoding cost — factor that into cost calc.

rachel: I'll prepare PR that gates soft-route by: (95p-latency > 500ms for 5m) OR (PCIe-retrain-rate > 10/min) AND tenant_egress > 200MB/s. rollback automatic on quality regressions.

mei: tracking incident INC-4582. I'll leave proxy policer for 1h and monitor. If stable after 1h, we schedule canary carveout next weekend.

tom: thanks. ping me if export clients need notice (may need minor SDK change for compressed stream).

alloc-bot: Monitoring snapshot: pci_retrain_count delta on rack-7 -> -86% within 2min of policer.

lee: solid work. keep logs for postmortem and include cost/runbook for automation.

rachel: PR draft by tomorrow AM. will include gzip/quantization benchmarks and perf delta.

mei: closing for now, will update after 60m with final recommendation. :white_check_mark:
